If you are new to using nbdev here are some useful pointers to get you started.

Install pymlx90642 in Development mode

title: pymlx90642
text:
Usage

Installation
Install latest from the GitHub repository:
$ pip install git+https://github.com/ecamo19/pymlx90642.git
or from conda
$ conda install -c ecamo19 pymlx90642
or from pypi
$ pip install pymlx90642


Documentation
Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub repository’s pages. Additionally you can find package manager specific guidelines on conda and pypi respectively.

title: pymlx90642
text:
Configure raspberry pi:

# Update system
sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y

# Install Python packages
sudo apt install i2c-tools -y


# Enable I2C interface
sudo raspi-config

# Navigate to: Interface Options > I2C > Yes

# Reboot
sudo reboot

# Verify I2C is working
sudo i2cdetect -y 1


# You should see device at address 0x33 (default MLX90642 address)
